answer: The defence rests on snooker league registration with frame score history: frames scored in one league across seasons. Forging 209 of these means building 209 separate frame histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. The plume test is the price tag: 209 fakes mean 209 payments. Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The vault signal is visible to every grader, and the violet ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
